title: Yummy Charred Punjabi Redcurrants Curry
description: A comforting one-pot curry that blends charred spices with sweet redcurrants and soft paneer, finished with a poached egg for an ovo-vegetarian twist.
instructions: Heat a hot pot over medium heat and add the oil until shimmering.
Add cumin and coriander seeds and toast until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until the onion turns translucent.
Stir in the fermented mustard seeds and garam masala and cook for another 30 seconds.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a gentle boil.
Add the redcurrants and reduce the heat to low, simmering for 10 minutes until the currants soften.
Add the paneer cubes and cook for 5 more minutes until heated through.
Season with salt to taste and stir gently.
Turn off the heat and let the curry sit for 2 minutes to meld the flavors.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a drizzle of fresh lime if desired.
Serve hot into bowls, optionally topping each serving with a poached egg.
Enjoy the charred aroma and comforting taste of this Punjabi redcurrants curry.
